regions.today: Today will bring sunshine and showers across Leinster, some heavy with a chance of hail and isolated thunderstorms. Cool for this time of year with highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees and moderate to fresh, gusty westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Clear spells and showers tonight, the showers heaviest and most frequent over the western half of the region. Chilly with lowest temperatures of 4 to 8 degrees, and light southwesterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be bright with sunny spells and scattered showers, which will gradually die out by early evening. Cloud will increase from the west through the evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees with moderate westerly winds.
